name: THE CHRONICLES DECK: The Fallen & the Virtuous (All-Foil Edition) Deck
cleanName: THE CHRONICLES DECK The Fallen and the Virtuous All Foil Edition Deck
extDescription:
Have you been watching Yu-Gi-Oh! CARD GAME: THE CHRONICLES? A new episode of these animated shorts is released every month, telling the stories of the monsters behind the cards, set in their own worlds!
The story running from June through November is The Fallen & The Virtuous, telling the tale of monsters like Fallen of Albaz and Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous.
Now you can enjoy this ongoing animated release even more with the THE CHRONICLES DECK: The Fallen & The Virtuous (All-Foil Edition). This 51-card all-foil Deck includes the key characters, places, and situations seen in the animated shorts, in their original monster, Spell, and Trap forms. It comes with 2 brand-new cards never seen before, 4 new variant arts of some old favorites, and foil versions of the most popular cards centered around Fallen of Albaz that Duelists have woven into their Decks these last five years!
The Main Deck and Extra Deck, combined, are 50 Ultra Rare Cards. The 51st card in each Deck is a Secret Rare repeat of one of the Deck’s Ultra Rare cards, but with a bonus chance to upgrade to Starlight Rare, instead! (Just like the foil upgrades in this year’s Structure Deck: Blue-Eyes White Destiny.)
THE CHRONICLES DECK: The Fallen & The Virtuous (All-Foil Edition) comes with 51 cards:
50 Ultra Rares
1 Secret Rare (a second copy of 1 of 6 of the Ultra Rare cards), with a small chance of being Starlight Rare instead of Secret Rare (And don’t forget about THE CHRONICLES: The Fallen & The Virtuous Card Sleeves, which you can pick up to keep your cards safe!)
